question: What great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together constitute a great accomplishment.
This accomplishment relates to the yoginīs.
Such accomplishment results in becoming dear to them.
inference: One who attains the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One may become dear to the yoginīs through the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation.
